strings.mission.mission_first_landing.name: Greybox Demo
strings.mission.mission_first_landing.briefing_b: Secure the landing zone, survey the nearby well, and remove the hostile force while communications are restored.
strings.mission.mission_first_landing.start_obje: Deploy the outpost and destroy the hostile force.
strings.mission.mission_first_landing.retry_hint: Keep the Commander behind the base line, then scout the enemy power route before committing infantry.
strings.mission.mission_first_landing.tactical_n: The enemy forward Pylon powers its central Extractor and tower wall.
strings.mission.mission_wells_at_the_ridge.name: Wells at the Ridge
strings.mission.mission_wells_at_the_ridge.brief: Expand deliberately from the landing zone, fight for the island well, and break the enemy Colony Hub.
strings.mission.mission_wells_at_the_ridge.start: Build your Colony Hub, secure wells, control the island crossing, and destroy the enemy Colony Hub.
strings.mission.mission_wells_at_the_ridge.retry: Deploy the Hub inside the landing clearing, secure the first well, then choose between the island well, bridge control, tower walls, or Guardian Retrofit.
strings.mission.mission_wells_at_the_ridge.tacti: Patrols probe the island lanes before the main attack timer; intact bridges allow crossings, broken bridges can be repaired by Grunts.
